purpose: Correctness and conformance checks only; never a field-performance or product-gain claim.

cases.title: AWGN SISO equals Shannon capacity
cases.expected: max_abs_error <= 1e-5 and capacity strictly increases with SNR

cases.title: Per-RB SVD is bounded by capacity and dominates the Type-I-style subset
cases.expected: zero bound violations and zero Type-I-over-SVD violations across 24 frozen channels

cases.title: Matched-prior LMMSE channel estimation suppresses low-SNR noise
cases.expected: LMMSE minus LS is significantly negative under the preregistered matched exponential PDP

cases.title: OLLA converges to the configured target BLER
cases.expected: target 0.10 lies inside the replication 95% CI and absolute mean error <= 0.02

cases.title: PF occupies the throughput-fairness middle ground
cases.expected: max-C/I throughput exceeds PF while PF Jain fairness exceeds max-C/I, both through CRN Gate 3

cases.title: EBF/PEBF/NEBF reproduce the expected SU and correlated-MU counterexample
cases.expected: SU NEBF is within 5% of EBF and above PEBF; correlated MU has NEBF leakage and NEBF sum-SE below PEBF

cases.title: UL-SRS reciprocity mapping restores the DL precoding convention
cases.expected: correct conjugate mapping beats the wrong convention and reaches at least 90% of ideal-CSI SE

cases.title: Jakes correlation and coherence time use the correct Doppler time scale
cases.expected: rho matches scipy J0 to 1e-12 and Tcoh(3 km/h)/Tcoh(30 km/h) is between 8 and 12

cases.title: 38.214 TBS allocation is monotone but not safely linearized
cases.expected: all 224 D/S x MCS x rank sequences are strictly increasing; the frozen MCS12/rank2 full-band point differs from one-RBG linear extrapolation by 0.5%-2%

cases.title: A freshly generated 38.901 channel passes the full independent gate set
cases.expected: 18 checks execute and no blocking check fails; calibration caveats remain visible
